description.value: Mission Hill Family Estate is a landmark Okanagan winery perched high above the valley with sweeping views of mountains, vineyards, and Okanagan Lake. Named Canada's Winery of the Year a record six times and listed among the World's 50 Best Vineyards in 2025, it offers curated tasting experiences, a fine-dining Terrace Restaurant, and a summer concert series in an outdoor amphitheatre. Access to the estate requires a reservation or membership, though same-day bookings are accommodated when space is available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and operating, corroborates the OSM phone number and address (with a municipality discrepancy noted below). No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those are all null. The website establishes Mission Hill as a reservation-or-members-only estate with a fine-dining restaurant and tasting experiences, making it a legitimate cycling-tourism destination in the Okanagan.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Kelowna' but the website address page clearly states 'West Kelowna, BC' — these are separate municipalities; the OSM community field may be incorrect.
OSM opening_hours tag states closing at 18:00 but the website lists closing at 7:00 PM (19:00); the website value is likely current.
Estate access requires reservation or wine club membership; drop-in cyclist visits may not always be possible, which is an important caveat for directory users.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Mission Hill is one of BC's most celebrated wineries and a flagship Okanagan cycling-tourism destination; it belongs in the directory, with a note that visits require advance reservation.

wow_evidence: Named Canada's Winery of the Year a record six times and listed among the World's 50 Best Vineyards in 2025
